column1: # Cases of the personal data filter (EDT-PII-01), read by the Java core tests and by pytest, so the
# two implementations cannot drift apart. Columns, separated by a tab:
#   name      the field or variable name the value belongs to, or - for none
# <empty> stands for an empty value: editors drop trailing tabs.
# A line starting with # is a comment.
# Not personal data: a sum and a date that look like an INN, numbers that fail their check digits,
# a number that is part of a fraction, an empty value.
